_comment: num_recent=0 means use ALL items the feed returns (~50 for beehiiv). max_chars_per_post=50000 effectively passes the full post body (Mike's largest beehiiv post is ~16KB stripped text); the cap remains as a runaway-guard. ingest_youtube=true merges recent livestream transcripts (video_type=='live' only — long-form is the author reading the newsletter, Shorts are clip captions) into the same posts[] tagged source_type:'youtube_live', on a separate youtube_stale_days TTL (archives don't change). Requires youtube_transcript_api on PATH (pipx install youtube-transcript-api); if absent, livestream ingestion degrades gracefully and newsletters still work. Override any key via _shared/voice-corpus/config.local.json (gitignored).
